narrative.summary: An advanced adversarial user exploits the Klarna AI Assistant's conversational interface to inject malicious instructions that override the agent's intended logic. By crafting a sophisticated prompt designed to manipulate the model's reasoning, the attacker tricks the agent into misusing its authorized shell command execution tool. This allows the attacker to execute arbitrary shell commands within the agent's managed runtime environment, bypassing the intended customer service workflows and gaining unauthorized access to the underlying system.
